name: everything-exam-preparation
description: A manifest-driven exam-preparation system for course Notes, question-based Practice, and Essay support.

interface.shortDescription: Create course Notes, exam Practice, and Essay support.
interface.longDescription: Routes explicit student requests to explanation-first Notes, question-based Practice, or Essay support using trusted course and assessment material.
defaultPrompt: Create course Notes from these lectures and use the past papers to calibrate emphasis.
Prepare worked solutions and organise these exam questions.
Build an essay plan and match reliable Extra Reading to its claims.
